## Discover Elementary Number Theory

I am a coauthor, with Gaurav Bhatnagar and Sagar Shrivastava, of *Discover Elementary Number Theory*. The book grew out of a course we taught for the Lodha Genius Programme in 2024, based loosely on Hardy and Wright’s *An Introduction to the Theory of Numbers*. Our aim was to break some of its ideas into sequences of problems that students could work through for themselves. The students worked through a new problem sheet each day, and were largely Ashoka undergraduates interning with the programme.

[Read more about the book](https://gauravbhatnagar.org/2026/08/22/discover-elementary-number-theory/)
